environment.name: SERVERURL
environment.prompt: Public address peers connect to, or auto to detect it (vpn.example.com)

environment.name: SERVERPORT
environment.prompt: Public UDP port peers connect to

environment.name: PEERS
environment.prompt: Peers to create: a number (3) or a list of names (phone,laptop)

environment.name: PEERDNS
environment.prompt: DNS server written in the peer configurations (auto or an IP address)

environment.name: INTERNAL_SUBNET
environment.prompt: Internal subnet of the tunnel (change it only if it clashes)

environment.name: ALLOWEDIPS
environment.prompt: Networks the peers reach through the tunnel (0.0.0.0/0 = all traffic)

completion_notes: Each peer gets its configuration and its QR code inside the container: /config/peer1/peer1.conf and /config/peer1/peer1.png, or /config/peer_<name>/peer_<name>.conf when names were given.
Show the QR code of a peer again with: pct exec <CTID> -- /app/show-peer 1
Copy a peer configuration to the host with: pct pull <CTID> /config/peer1/peer1.conf peer1.conf
Peers reach the server through the public address and the UDP port given during the installation, so that port must be forwarded to this container.
Adding peers later means raising PEERS in /etc/pve/lxc/<CTID>.conf and restarting the container. The existing peer keys are kept.

tagline.en_US: WireGuard® is an extremely simple yet fast and modern VPN that utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPsec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN. WireGuard is designed as a general purpose VPN for running on embedded interfaces and super computers alike, fit for many different circumstances. Initially released for the Linux kernel, it is now cross-platform (Windows, macOS, BSD, iOS, Android) and widely deployable. It is currently under heavy development, but already it might be regarded as the most secure, easiest to use, and simplest VPN solution in the industry.

description.en_US: WireGuard is a virtual private network protocol and tool that establishes secure point-to-point connections. It provides encrypted tunneling across local networks and the internet with low resource overhead. The application can run in either server or client mode to securely link remote devices and route traffic.
